description: Version → capability → the file that demonstrates it. Generated by scripts/version-capability-ledger.ts and checked on every PR: a version that claims a capability with no file behind it fails. The failure names the version, because a version's claims are what is wrong when the file is gone — editing the ledger to match the tree would make it a mirror.

entries.capability: A coverage gate that cannot be satisfied by a partial run
The sample count a straddling rule is quoted is the arithmetic answer
A tier is an executable ratchet, not a sentence
A declared core claim carries an owner and an expiry
A quarantined rule has an owner and a review date too
A capability is advertised only at the level its own evidence supports
A configuration file nobody reads is a claim the repository does not make
